subject: Business Models
title: Instagram's Pre-Launch Pivot
description: A quick win: understand Instagram's Pre-Launch Pivot.

hook.text: Instagram was originally called Burbn—a check-in app like Foursquare. Nobody used the check-in feature.

buildup.text: Kevin Systrom noticed one feature got all the engagement: photo sharing with filters.

discovery.text: They stripped everything else out. Burbn became Instagram: photos, filters, sharing. Nothing else.

twist.text: Instagram hit 1 million users in 2 months. Facebook bought it for $1 billion 18 months after launch.

climax.text: The pivot wasn't grand strategy—it was listening to user behavior and removing everything they didn't use.

punchline.text: Check-in app nobody used. Stripped it to photos only. $1 billion in 18 months.

quiz.question: What was Instagram's original product called?
